blackWhale3dPrinciples: Geometry never upgrades the certainty of a factual claim.
Archive data owns truth; scene files own presentation.
Every visible reconstruction state exposes its certainty and evidence path.
Chapter-safe views must not leak later knowledge.
A non-3D equivalent is required for every critical interaction and fact.
The archive remains complete and useful when the 3D viewer is unavailable.

included: Black Whale exterior and cross-section reconstruction
Five-tier structural volumes and known inter-tier bands
Known rooms, zones, portals, routes, and operational closures
Chapter-bounded occupancy, movement, control, and event states
Evidence-linked analytical overlays, including optional Nen layers
Desktop research mode plus accessible non-3D equivalents
excluded: A full Hunter × Hunter video game or combat system
A claim that the complete floor plan is canon
NPC artificial intelligence, multiplayer, economy, or progression systems
VR or AR as a baseline requirement
Physics simulation unless a later evidence-backed interaction requires it
Replacing the existing Black Whale atlas, dossiers, or chapter tools

blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.label: Confirmed
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.minimumEvidence: At least one direct approved source record establishing the represented spatial fact.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.geometryRule: Geometry may represent only the shape, adjacency, route, or location actually supported. Unshown dimensions remain approximate even inside a confirmed room.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.renderTreatment: Solid canonical material with a visible Confirmed badge.

blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.label: Strong reconstruction
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.minimumEvidence: Two or more compatible approved records, or one direct record plus an unavoidable spatial relationship.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.geometryRule: The broad relationship may be solid, but exact measurements, bends, door positions, and decoration remain approximate.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.renderTreatment: Solid geometry with reconstruction hatching and a persistent evidence badge.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.claimLanguage: reconstructed as, evidence places, likely connects

blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.label: Functional reconstruction
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.minimumEvidence: A confirmed need for circulation or structure, with no claim that the exact route or form is shown.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.geometryRule: Use the minimum neutral architecture required for navigation. Decorative specificity is prohibited.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.renderTreatment: Neutral simplified geometry with reduced material detail and an Approximate badge.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.claimLanguage: functional connector, navigation proxy, approximate passage

blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.label: Speculative visualization
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.minimumEvidence: A documented open question or competing interpretation. Pure invention is not eligible.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.geometryRule: May illustrate one bounded hypothesis only. It cannot be required for navigation or event playback.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.renderTreatment: Transparent wireframe, disabled by default, with Speculative wording in every entry point.

blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.label: Unknown
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.minimumEvidence: The archive knows that a space, connection, or extent is unresolved or undocumented.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.geometryRule: Omit the interior, seal the boundary, or show a non-traversable unknown volume. Do not invent circulation through it.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.renderTreatment: Dark sealed volume, void, or labelled omission with no architectural detail.
blackWhale3dCertaintyLevels.claimLanguage: unknown, unresolved, not shown, not yet established

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Programme identity
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: BW3D Phase 7.0 is explicitly separated from historical archive Phase 7A–7G naming.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Source transparency
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Every lore, image, community, generated, and reconstruction source records its provenance, purpose, and certainty; source type alone does not automatically promote or reject a claim.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Certainty taxonomy
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: All five certainty states define evidence, visibility, traversal, wording, and rendering behavior.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Unknown-space protection
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Unknown interiors and routes cannot become navigable production geometry without a reviewed evidence-state change.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Coordinate and scale contract
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: The right-handed meter-based ship frame, axes, origin, transforms, and scale-confidence rule are locked.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Stable naming
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Scene, asset, route, snapshot, overlay, and view IDs follow one audited pattern and link back to archive identities.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Data/geometry separation
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Facts, sources, chapters, and certainty live outside glTF; geometry contains stable IDs and rendering metadata only.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Technical baseline
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: React/Vite, Three.js/R3F, glTF 2.0, WebGL 2, compression, state, testing, and non-goals are recorded without prematurely adding dependencies.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Spoiler and time boundary
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Chapter-safe, omniscient, and character-perspective rules prevent later knowledge leakage.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Accessible parity
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Every critical 3D interaction and fact has a keyboard path, reduced-motion behavior, and non-3D equivalent.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Performance ceiling
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: Initial asset, memory, triangle, streaming, and frame-rate budgets are explicit and amendable only through review.

blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.label: Build enforcement
blackWhale3dAcceptanceGates.pass: The machine-readable charter, schema, documentation, ownership record, and dedicated audit are part of aggregate preflight.

acceptedLoreEvidence: Hunterpedia image-gallery or approved static image records
Locally stabilized derivatives retaining approved article and image provenance
Existing archive records that already resolve to approved sources and explicit evidence states
Other sourced materials, including community references and generated reconstruction aids, when provenance, purpose, and certainty are explicitly labeled
blackWhale3dSourceContract.technicalDocumentationBoundary: Official technical documentation may guide implementation, but it cannot establish Hunter × Hunter lore or ship architecture.
blackWhale3dSourceContract.externalEvidencePolicy: Fan maps, forum diagrams, social posts, videos, generated concepts, architectural analogies, and previous reconstructions may inform the project when they are labeled by source and certainty. They must not be silently presented as direct manga confirmation.

blackWhale3dCoordinateSystem.originDefinition: The ship-local centerline reference used by every exported asset. Its final physical placement is established during spatial graph and blockout work, not guessed in Phase 7.0.

transformContract.position: Three numbers in meters relative to the ship origin.
transformContract.rotation: Normalized quaternion [x, y, z, w]. Euler angles are authoring-only and never canonical data.
transformContract.scale: Three positive values. Production assets export at [1, 1, 1].

blackWhale3dCoordinateSystem.scaleRule: One scene unit equals one meter. Any unverified global or local measurement carries an explicit scaleConfidence field and cannot be described as exact.

blackWhale3dTechnicalStack.helperPolicy: @react-three/drei may be used selectively; helpers must not hide evidence state, loading, disposal, accessibility, or performance behavior.
blackWhale3dTechnicalStack.state: React state for local controls; Zustand for viewer-wide scene, chapter, selection, and overlay state once implementation begins.
blackWhale3dTechnicalStack.geometryCompression: EXT_meshopt_compression preferred; Draco allowed only where measured benefit justifies its decoder cost.
blackWhale3dTechnicalStack.textureDelivery: KTX2/Basis Universal for production textures, with ordinary image fallback only when compatibility requires it.
blackWhale3dTechnicalStack.experimentalRenderer: WebGPU may be evaluated after feature, accessibility, and visual parity. It is not a Phase 7 baseline or release requirement.
blackWhale3dTechnicalStack.dependencyRule: Phase 7.0 records the stack but does not add runtime 3D dependencies. Exact package versions are pinned when the first executable viewer begins.

blackWhale3dAccessibilityContract.parityRule: Every critical 3D fact and action has a semantic list, ledger, search result, or direct command outside the canvas.
required: Keyboard access to viewer controls, room selection, tier isolation, and exit
Reduced-motion replacements for camera travel and playback
Written event and movement playback status
No information communicated only through color, opacity, animation, depth, or sound
A non-WebGL fallback that preserves room, route, evidence, chapter, and status data
Touch controls with the maintained target-size contract
prohibited: Pointer-lock as the only navigation mode
Canvas-only text required to understand a claim
